claims.claim: For a frozen capacitated bipartite eligibility graph, the maximum common demand fraction equals min(1, min over nonempty site subsets U of S(N(U))/D(U)).
Full demand is routable exactly when every nonempty site subset satisfies the capacitated Hall condition S(N(U)) >= D(U).
Increasing capacity only at a source outside the neighborhood of an active minimizing site subset cannot improve the certified common fulfillment fraction.
exclusions: claims that every neighboring capacity increase is sufficient

claims.claim: The certificate of the intersection of scenario eligibility graphs cannot exceed the certificate of any individual scenario; the edge union is not a robust substitute.
The final preregistered executable gate completed 15 PASS / 0 FAIL / 15 CHECKS after a preserved numerical-tolerance failure and disclosed repair.
Adequate total seed inventory can coexist with an arbitrarily small common fulfillment fraction when eligibility neighborhoods are imbalanced.
exclusions: empirical frequency or magnitude in any real seed system

claims_explicitly_not_made: eligibility edges biologically or legally valid
procurement, policy, genetic-resource, or phytosanitary approval
canon, spine, ledger, publication, adoption, demand, delivery, payment, repeat use, or MRR readiness
